project_type: TensorFlow 2.10 groupwise brain MRI registration (research code), standalone inference CLI predict.py + inference/ package, CPU evaluation package evaluation/, SLURM wrappers slurm/*.sh
language: Python 3.8 syntax (cluster container py3.8.10, TF 2.10, numpy 1.21, scipy 1.4, nibabel 3.1); bash for SLURM scripts
build_system: none (plain Python package, run from the repo root). Windows workspace d:\Research\Brain_Registration_Projects\brain-group-rad; tests run in WSL Ubuntu at /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad with conda envs tf_gpu (TF 2.10 + GPU, py3.9; NEVER set a TF GPU memory limit above 6000 MB) and bgr_preproc38 (py3.8, numpy 1.21, scipy 1.4.1, no TF). `set +u` before `conda activate`.
test_framework: unittest. Every TF test module imports `from tests import tf_setup` FIRST. TF-free modules (no tensorflow import) run in bgr_preproc38 in stage 1 of tests/run_tests_wsl.sh.
build_command: py3.8 syntax: in bgr_preproc38 `python -m py_compile <files>` (helper: bash .agents/tasks/tta/run_tests.sh compile)
test_command: Targeted: `wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.agents/tasks/tta/run_tests.sh tf tests.test_tta` (TF modules, env TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512 BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 set by the helper) or `... run_tests.sh py38 tests.test_predict_store` (TF-free). Full suite (~7 h, only in the final integration step, background): `wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh`.
verification_instructions: 1) Run the FEAT's targeted test modules with the helper and paste the 'Ran N tests ... OK' lines into the FEAT's test log .agents/tasks/tta/test-log-FEAT-00N.md (command, date, result, counts, skips). 2) py_compile of every new/changed .py in bgr_preproc38. 3) bash -n on new/changed SLURM scripts (helper: run_tests.sh bashn <files>). 4) The T9 golden tests.test_predict_tta_golden must pass after every engine/runner/CLI change. Reviewers read the test log and the working-tree diff (git diff + new files) and do NOT re-run suites.
snapshot_or_generated_files: tests/fixtures/predict_tta_off_golden.json: written ONCE in FEAT-001 on the unchanged tree with BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN=1 (run_tests.sh passes the env through); never regenerated after a source change. Existing goldens tests/fixtures/m7_linear_golden.json, lncc_deform_golden.json must not change.
environment_constraints: Do NOT commit, push, or submit cluster jobs (the orchestrator does). Work directly on branch main in d:\Research\Brain_Registration_Projects\brain-group-rad (no worktree). Use absolute Windows paths with file tools; relative paths resolve against the workspace root. PowerShell 5.1 strips inner double quotes of native-command args: call the WSL helper script instead of long inline bash -c strings. Local GPU GTX 1080 8 GB under WSL; tf_gpu crashes CPU-only (keep the GPU visible). TF tests at the full level-1 grid run on /CPU:0 only where existing tests already do. Leave Jay's untracked .agents/tasks/smoothness-scaling/ alone.
contribution_requirements: Python 3.8 only (no PEP 585/604 at runtime, no str.removeprefix, no 3.9+ stdlib); numpy 1.21 / scipy 1.4 APIs (scipy.stats.wilcoxon(d, zero_method='pratt') without alternative/mode, binom_test not binomtest -- fall back to binomtest only if binom_test is missing); no new dependencies. Default --tta none must be bit-identical to HEAD 19b8a60 behaviour. No TTA in training-time validation, eval_synth, LUMIR-val, check-streaming or --mode unchunked (Jay 12.1). Plain mean of re-encoded 10-D entries, no weighting option; all 8 flips; any N >= 2. Follow existing conventions: module docstrings citing the design section, logging via logging.getLogger(__name__), PredictError codes (2 input, 3 non-finite, 1 unexpected), TF-free CLI (inference/cli.py must not import TF), tf.function caching via the classes' _fn(key, body).
key_patterns: Streamed engine: inference/streaming.py StreamedLevel (passes P0-P12, host store names prefix 'L<level>_', _put/_get/_free, _fn caching, stats dict). Runner: inference/runner.py StreamedRunner (_engine cache self._engines, _linear/_deform default path, _linear_sel/_deform_sel for --levels plans, phases timing context, summary dict). Records: inference/predict.py PREDICT_KEYS (exact key-set test), _new_record, _command_wrapper writes the JSON last, _setup_levels pattern for plan validation, _peek_chain_configs for TF-free chain configs. Goldens: env BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN=1 writes the fixture, else compare (tests/test_trainer.py TestDeformUnchanged). Determinism: tests/test_trainer.py _OpDeterminism context. Tiny checkpoints: tests/predict_helpers.py save_level4_run / save_cascade_run / write_subjects; tiny in-memory models: tests/test_predict_runner.py _level4 / _level2 (tiny_config(**STAGE_KW)), LoadedModel(level, model, frozen). SLURM scripts: #SBATCH -A qtim, -p, --gpus=1, -N 1, --ntasks-per-node=1, --cpus-per-task, --mem, --time, --output/--error under $PROJ/logs, 'DO NOT submit without Jay's approval', set -uo pipefail, singularity exec ... </dev/null; asserted line by line in tests/test_slurm_scripts.py.
relevant_files: inference/levels.py (parse_levels, LevelPlan.run/last/kind, pattern for exposure checks)
inference/loader.py (LoadedModel: level, levels, config, model_cfg, stage_models(), frozen; load_model)

models/transforms.py (encode_10d, decode_10d, rigid_matrix, affine_matrix, flip_matrix, flip_conjugate, flip_images, barycenter, center_group, GroupCentering, barycentric_targets, brain_second_moment)
directory_structure: inference/ = standalone prediction (store, streaming engine, loader, runner, canonical writer, levels, cli, predict); models/ = TF model code (transforms, cascade, diffeo, group_net); runtime/ = trainer, metrics, fixed_data; evaluation/ = CPU evaluation (python -m evaluation); scripts/ = analysis helpers; slurm/ = cluster job scripts; tests/ = unittest modules (+ fixtures/ goldens, predict_helpers.py); .agents/tasks/tta/ = design, plan, feature artifacts, test logs, reviews, verdict gates, final report.
